title: Orchestrated Announcement Matrix and Sprint Timeline for Catalyst Launch
creator: Aisha Karim
description: Create a coordinated, timeboxed announcement plan that aligns blog, marketing email, social posts, product release notes, and a technical webinar for the Catalyst feature set. Goal: maximize coverage for developer audiences while keeping launch operations simple and auditable. Deliverables: announcement matrix, final copy for all channels, embargo schedule, stakeholder contact list, and post-launch analysis checklist.
acceptance_criteria: One consolidated announcement matrix exists with channel owners and publish windows
All copy for primary channels (blog, marketing email, 3 social threads, webinar deck, release notes) has owner sign-off
Legal and security sign-off (if required) is recorded in linked_confluence doc
Publishing runbook and rollback steps documented and verified with Operations
Post-launch dashboard (traffic, errors, signup lift) defined and shared with stakeholders

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Last-minute API behavior change breaks examples. Mitigation: Feature toggle and ability to rollback docs updates within 1 hour; Eng to keep hotfix branch open.
Risk: Negative performance claim flagged by legal. Mitigation: Use conservative numbers, link to benchmark repo, and include methodology appendix.
Risk: Webinar attendance lower than expected. Mitigation: Coordinate pre-event teasers in community channels and offer on-demand recording with gated signup to capture leads.
Risk: Publish rate limits cause email delays. Mitigation: Phased email rollout and contingency to pause broad send if error rate > 5%.
Risk: Timezone coordination causes community confusion. Mitigation: Publish UTC time in all channels and schedule social posts for region-local times via Hootsuite.

notes: Objective: make the launch repeatable for future features with a compact matrix that fits a single-page TL;DR for execs. Keep the developer-focused content high-signal: code snippets, quickstart, and reproducible benchmarks. Track post-launch uplift in both signups and API request volume.
